title: New Product Launch Video and Photos | AIVideosUGC
description: Create launch videos and photos from one product image. Make a short preview, a reveal, and a listing photo before launch day. No studio booking or reshoot.
h1: Create Your Product Launch Video and Photos Fast
lead: Turn the sample photo into a preview you can share. Add the launch date when that date is real.

faq.q: How do credits work for a launch photo or video?
faq.a: A photo spends 24 credits. A video spends 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, and 120 for 30. You see that cost before you confirm the job. If it fails, those credits return.

faq.q: Can my own tools request launch videos?
faq.a: Yes. Your tools can ask for a launch preview from a product link through the API. The file stays in your account until you share it.

faq.q: Can an AI avatar appear in the preview?
faq.a: Yes. An AI avatar can stand beside the product in the preview. Leave the avatar out if you want the product alone.

faq.q: How do I change the end time?
faq.a: Set it in the editor and move it if the day changes. You decide when the preview stops pointing at that moment.

faq.q: Can I bring my own product footage into the preview?
faq.a: Yes. Upload the clip or the photo you already have. It can sit with the avatar and the script.

faq.q: Will anyone else see my unreleased product?
faq.a: No. The upload and the result stay in your account, and they are not published until you share them.

faq.q: What frame should the launch video use?
faq.a: A product photo is square. For a phone video, use tall 9:16. Use square 1:1 for a square post, wide 16:9 for a wide page, or 4:3 and 3:4 when the placement asks for them.

faq.q: How long can the launch clip be?
faq.a: Clips run 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Six seconds fits a quick reveal. Use 15 or 30 seconds when the launch needs a fuller product story.

faq.q: Can I make launch videos for many products at once?
faq.a: Yes. Run several product links and each one comes back as its own preview. Check every file before it is published.

faq.q: Can I add a voice, music, and captions?
faq.a: Yes. Turn captions on after you read the line, then pick a voice you would use at the counter. A music track is optional, and only one you are allowed to play.

faq.q: Can I publish the preview to TikTok, Instagram, or YouTube?
faq.a: Yes. Post the saved preview on the channel that is launching the product.

faq.q: Can I change the launch date after the video is made?
faq.a: Yes. Move the end time or the date line in the editor, so a new day does not mean a new scene.

trust.h2: Private Until You Share the Look
trust.lead: The photo stays with you, and the date is yours to add.

items.d: The upload and the result stay in your account. They are not published until you share them.

items.t: An End Time You Can Move
items.d: Set the end time and change it in the editor if launch day moves. The date sits in the editor, and the product picture stays as shot.
The download has no AIVideosUGC watermark, so launch posts and paid ads are fine. Each app still has its own rules.
You know the spend before you commit, so the preview stays on budget. A photo spends 24 credits. A video spends 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.

items.t: A Failed Job Returns the Credits
items.d: If the job fails, those credits return on their own. A finished file is not refunded just because you dislike it.

items.t: An Avatar or the Product Alone
items.d: You can leave the preview on the product alone, or pick an AI avatar from the library. When a person appears, that person is generated.
